description: Whale and large-trade tracker for an ERC-20 on Polygon PoS: every buy and sell in the last N minutes on the token's deepest WPOL/USDC pools (Uniswap v3), with USD size, side, wallet and transaction for the largest trades, buy/sell volume and net flow, and the wallets that bought or sold the most. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

minUsd.description: Only list trades at least this large in USD, default 1000

minutes.description: Look-back window in minutes; 5 to 240, default 60 (capped at 12,000 blocks, about 50 minutes on Arbitrum)

token.description: Token contract address on Polygon PoS

name: polygon_large_trades
